title: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis Related Chronic Cough Reduction with NAL ER Tablets (OCEAN-1)
official: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Nalbuphine Extended- Release Tablets for the Treatment of Chronic Cough in Participants with Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) (OCEAN-1)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effect of NAL ER on 24-hour cough frequency (coughs per hour) using objective cough monitor
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Written informed consent and authorization for release and use of protected health information. 2. Participants ≥40 years old at the time of informed consent. 3. Diagnosis of IPF as determined by the Investigator based on ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT clinical practice guidelines. 4. Chronic cough for ≥8 weeks prior to Screening.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Clinical diagnosis or clinical suspicion of an upper or lower respiratory tract infection in the last 8 weeks prior to the Screening visit or during Screening. 2. Hospitalization for any respiratory illness (including acute exacerbation of IPF) within 8 weeks prior to Screening. 3. Diagnosed sleep apnea or currently on any treatment for sleep apnea (e.g., CPAP).
